title_zh: 零号门 1:1 样机空间备选裁决
scope: One reversible gate prototype within a provisional key-area context; dimensions are design inputs pending survey and professional review.

hard_gates.label_zh: 试验区不占用公共路径
hard_gates.label_en: Trial bay does not occupy the public route

hard_gates.label_zh: 人工岗位可看见入口与退出
hard_gates.label_en: Staff post sees both entry and exit

hard_gates.label_zh: 最远急停到人工岗位不超过 25 米
hard_gates.label_en: Farthest emergency stop is within 25 m of staff

hard_gates.label_zh: 构件可逆并有独立撤场路线
hard_gates.label_en: Components are reversible with an independent removal path

alternatives.reason_zh: 门架和试验区跨越连续通行线，普通服务与撤场路线均被试验占用。
alternatives.reason_en: The frame and trial bay cross the continuous public route, so both ordinary service and removal depend on the trial.

alternatives.reason_zh: 普通路径成立，但双侧设备分散导致值守视线和最远急停距离不合格。
alternatives.reason_en: The ordinary route works, but split equipment breaks staff sightlines and exceeds the emergency-stop distance.

alternatives.reason_zh: 普通路径、人工台、试验湾和撤场路线并列，AI 关闭或撤除后基本任务仍可完成。
alternatives.reason_en: The ordinary route, staffed desk, trial bay and removal path sit in parallel, so the basic task survives AI shutdown or removal.

first_100_days.action_zh: 锁定测绘、权属、文保、消防、无障碍与运营责任清单
first_100_days.action_en: Lock survey, ownership, heritage, fire, accessibility and operating-responsibility checklists

first_100_days.action_zh: 与使用者和维护者复核同任务人工基线，记录现状而不预填成功值
first_100_days.action_en: Review same-task human baselines with users and maintainers without pre-filling success values

first_100_days.action_zh: 搭建一座不附着文物的可逆 1:1 样机，保留连续无设备路径
first_100_days.action_en: Build one reversible 1:1 mock-up away from heritage fabric while preserving a continuous no-device route

first_100_days.action_zh: 主动演练断电、断网、责任人缺席、拥挤、无障碍受阻和投诉积压六类负例
first_100_days.action_en: Actively rehearse power, network, staff, crowding, accessibility and appeal failures

first_100_days.action_zh: 由具名人类责任方决定继续、修改、缩小或退出，并公开理由
first_100_days.action_en: Named human authorities decide to continue, revise, narrow or exit and publish the reason

limitations: No site survey, permission, procurement, installation, recruited-user test or operating result is claimed.
The 1.8 m and 25 m thresholds are proposal design gates, not approved engineering controls.
Official geometry and professional review must replace provisional coordinates and dimensions before implementation.
